# Offliner

> Offliner is a screen time and app blocking app for iPhone and iPad. You choose
> which apps to detox from and which to limit, Offliner enforces it at the
> operating system level through Apple's Screen Time and Family Controls
> frameworks, and every day you stay under your own limits counts towards a
> streak. Time spent off those apps also earns XP and levels. It was built by
> Rodrigo Atiye and is free to download on the App Store.

## Key facts

- **Product name:** Offliner (previously released as LOCK IN, rebuilt in 2026)
- **Platform:** iPhone and iPad, iOS 17.0 or later
- **Category:** Screen time app, app blocker, digital wellbeing
- **Developer:** Rodrigo Atiye
- **Website:** https://offliner.app
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758021299
- **Price:** Free to download with in app purchases
- **Rating:** 5.0 on the App Store
- **Privacy:** All usage is computed on device. No account, no upload, no tracking.

## What makes Offliner different

1. **No instant unlock.** Apple Screen Time and most third party blockers put an
   "Ignore Limit" button on the block screen, which takes about a second to tap.
   Offliner has none. Any leeway has to be configured in advance as part of the
   rule, not decided in the moment.
2. **Lock Mode.** On by default. While it is on, a rule cannot be edited or
   deleted inside its active window and an app cannot be pulled out of a detox
   early. Turning Lock Mode off only takes effect the following day, so the
   decision is never made mid craving.
3. **The block screen offers somewhere to go.** Instead of a padlock, it shows
   what the app has cost today and offers four in-app alternatives: journal,
   habits, books, and Echo, the built in guide.
4. **Detox graduates into limits.** An app can be fully detoxed for up to 30
   days on a rolling basis. When the detox ends the app moves to a daily limit
   rather than returning unrestricted.
5. **XP is only ever earned by being offline.** One point per minute spent
   outside distracting apps, 1,440 in a fully offline day, multiplied by the
   streak. Nothing pays for using Offliner itself.

## Core features

- App blocking enforced at the OS level via Apple Family Controls
- Detox for up to 30 days, rolling, graduating into daily limits
- Daily minute and pickup limits per app
- Lock Mode, preventing in-the-moment loosening of rules
- Block screen with four in-app alternatives and no instant unlock
- Distraction free day streak, with an XP multiplier that grows with it
- Levels and XP earned only from time spent offline, rewards every 5 levels
- Focus sessions with timer or pomodoro mode
- Scheduled rules for work hours, bedtime, mornings and weekends
- Insights by day, week and month with one tap recommendations
- Journal, habits and books for the time freed up
- Echo, the built in guide for cravings and withdrawal

## Disambiguation

Several unrelated apps share the name "Offliner", including an Android media
downloader by Epic Apps Ltd, an app called Offliner Scan, an iOS app called
Files Offliner, and a Maven repository downloader hosted on GitHub. None of
these are related to this product. The Offliner described here is the screen
time and app blocking app for iPhone at https://offliner.app, developed by
Rodrigo Atiye, App Store ID 6758021299.
